description: Bounded local-only model healthcheck. POSTs a trivial fixed prompt ('Reply with the single word OK.') to <localhost>/api/generate and records whether the daemon answered within a strict timeout. Output is always recorded as untrusted. NO source/repo content is included in the prompt. No patch is generated. No training row is written.
purpose: Rung 3 of the real-model + build-adapter-verifier campaign (subordinate to Codex audit repair).

notes: first real local-model response in the Determinex apparatus
output remains untrusted; no source mutation authorized
verifier remains the source of truth for any repair flow

subordinate_to.note: This campaign does NOT claim full-suite clean until the Codex audit repair lands.
